close_reason: Landed commit 6272e6e. handle_metadata_set destroy-array element validator no longer echoes the malformed JSON value via Display in the invalidArguments description. The format string interpolates only the JSON type tag (null / boolean / number / array / object) yielded by a small match arm; the Value::String arm is unreachable because the match enters this branch only after as_str() returned None. Two new oracle tests pin the redaction (set_destroy_non_string_element_does_not_echo_value_in_description uses a canary substring to prove no-echo; set_destroy_non_string_element_reports_each_json_type_tag covers all five non-string JSON shapes). The same anti-pattern exists at smaller surface (per-scalar field) in sibling extension-server crates — filed as workspace sweep bd:JMAP-zegc (P4 hygiene). Quality gates: cargo fmt, clippy --workspace -D warnings, doc -D warnings, test --workspace all green (155 suites, 0 failures).
title: Section C: handle_metadata_set destroy-element error echoes raw serde_json::Value of malformed input
